title: JSON output for podman system hyperv-prep
body:
### Feature request description

The podman system hyperv-prep --status command currently only outputs human-readable text, requiring tools to parse stdout to extract structured information. Adding support for --format=json (or --json) would enable programmatic consumption of this data

### Suggest potential solution

Add a --format=json flag (or --json) to output structured data:
  podman system hyperv-prep --status --format=json
```
  {
    "isGroupMember": true,
    "hasRegistryEntries": false,
    "status": "notApplied"
  }
```
### Have you considered any alternatives?

_No response_
